title: The phUSD mint leg's bare `catch { }` discards the revert reason, so PhUSDMintFailed records THAT the mint failed but not WHY -- the sibling contract in the same repo does this correctly
description: The bare `catch { }` at :914 discards the revert reason from the phUSD mint. PhUSDMintFailed records THAT the mint failed but not WHY. The sibling migrator in the same repo preserves the reason.
impact: Off-chain observability only. On-chain accounting is correct (INV-02/03/04 verified to hold). No value at risk.
recommendation: Use `catch (bytes memory reason)` and include the reason in PhUSDMintFailed, mirroring the sibling migrator.

importanceFlag.note: ELEVATED IMPORTANCE, NOT elevated severity. QA is the correct severity -- nothing on-chain depends on it. The classifier's importanceFlag is the right instrument.
importanceFlag.timing: ACTION NOW, ABI WINDOW CLOSING. This is an additive event-field change and therefore an ABI break for indexers: cheap now (story-031 unreleased), expensive later.
